draft.body: Give an AI agent a credit card and it can spend. It still can't answer for a loan, hold a balance sheet, or be trusted with a limit. Payments were the easy half. Vanna is the credit half: policy-bounded credit rails for agents and the businesses deploying them. On Stellar testnet.
